subject: oop
question: Write a Java program with a user-defined exception thrown when age is less than 18.
title: Throw It, Catch It
hook: Java has no rule for under-18s. A club bouncer does. Build him.
answer: User-defined exception class: class AgeException extends Exception { AgeException(String msg) { super(msg); } }
Method that checks: static void check(int age) throws AgeException { if (age < 18) throw new AgeException("Too young"); }
throw (no s) actually throws the exception object; throws (with s) in the method heading warns the caller.
main: try { check(15); } catch (AgeException e) { System.out.println(e.getMessage()); }
Output: Too young (15 is below 18, so check throws and main catches).
